messages:
Leah: quick check — where are we on the audit-log backfill schedule and who owns the KMS staging access handoff? need owners to confirm for the runbook before tomorrow's sync :eyes:
Devon: i can take lead on the backfill. plan is to run a rolling backfill starting wed night, low-traffic window. need a KMS staging key and access list from sec team.
Josh: @Devon pls ping me when you have the cutoff window so i can freeze writes to the shard. also we should do a canary query after batch 1.
Leah: thanks. @Anna can you confirm KMS staging key rotation policy for staging? want to avoid surprises during the handoff.
Anna: staging follows key-policy v2 (30d rotation). i can generate a one-off short-lived key for the backfill if sec approves. tagging security-bot for evidence/logging attach.
security-bot: @Anna — request noted. Please attach KMS request ticket ID when key created. Evidence: KMSREQ-8921. Automating audit log hook for creation events.
Devon: putting proposed schedule here:
```
Wed 23:00 - start backfill batch 1 (shard A)
Thu 02:00 - canary + validation
Thu 03:00 - proceed batch 2 (shard B)
Thu 06:00 - final reconciles + checksum
```
Leah: looks sensible. who's running validation queries? audit-bot can run the checksum but we need a human to review anomalies.
audit-bot: checksum job scheduled. results will post to #incidents and attach to ticket KMSREQ-8921. expected runtime ~18m per shard.
Josh: i'll run manual anomaly review for batch 1. if anything >0.1% mismatch i halt and tag @Devon @Anna.
Anna: FYI — access instructions for creating the short-lived key:
```
# create short-lived staging key
gcloud kms keys create backfill-temp --location=us-central1 --keyring=staging-ring --purpose=encryption
# grant only backfill service account
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding backfill-temp --member="serviceAccount:backfill-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoOperator"
```
Leah: perfect. @Devon can you update the runbook with those commands + ticket link? i'll sign off once the ticket has the key id + access list.
Devon: on it. i'll update runbook.md and push to the runbooks repo, then paste link here. planning to have it posted by 20:30 PT. :thumbsup:
Leah: last ask — can someone own the post-mortem note template? keep it lightweight: start time, end time, shards, total rows, mismatches, remediation.
Anna: i can own the template. will add it to the ticket and to the runbook under "post-action".
Leah: awesome. thanks team — i'll include this in tomorrow sync and confirm owners. closing for now unless blocker appears.
Devon: adding a quick follow-up: if anyone needs to test key creation in nonprod first, ping me and i'll spin one up.
Josh: acknowledged. i'll be on standby during canary.
security-bot: reminder: attach KMSREQ-8921 and the runbook link to the SOC2 evidence doc once done.
Leah: noted. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
